setting.Title: KPI-01 Avg annunciated alarms per 10 min (target ~1, max ~2)
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS NowTs, DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1), w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(hour, -24, NowTs) WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0), w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1), n32 AS (SELECT TOP (32) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n FROM sys.all_objects), days AS (SELECT n.n AS DayNo, DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) AS DayStart, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) END AS Ds, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) END AS De FROM w CROSS JOIN n32 n WHERE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.NowTs), a AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, t.[TimeStamp]) AS DayNo, k.Con AS Console, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.[_MaadenAMP3_DCS_ProcessAlarmsAMP3_2] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27C10','27C30','27C50','27C60','27C70','27C80','27C90') THEN 'Operator1' ELSE 'Operator2' END AS Con) k WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= w.StartTs AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' GROUP BY DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, t.[TimeStamp]), k.Con) SELECT CONVERT(varchar(6), d.DayStart, 106) + '

setting.Title: Operator 1 alarms per 10 min, last 24 h of the window (red = flood)
setting.Query:
WITH w0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(hour, 1 + DATEDIFF(hour, 0, COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@End')), ''), 120), GETDATE())), 0) AS NowTs,
 DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@Start')), ''), 120)), 0) AS S1),
w1 AS (SELECT NowTs, CASE WHEN S1 IS NULL OR S1 >= NowTs THEN DATEADD(hour, -24, NowTs) WHEN S1 < DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) THEN DATEADD(day, -31, NowTs) ELSE S1 END AS StartTs FROM w0),
w AS (SELECT NowTs, StartTs, CAST(CAST(StartTs AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w1),
s0 AS (SELECT DATEADD(minute, -1440, w.NowTs) AS StartTs FROM w),
nums AS (SELECT TOP (144) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS s FROM sys.all_objects),
cnt AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(minute, s0.StartTs, t.[TimeStamp]) / 10 AS s, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM dbo.[_MaadenAMP3_DCS_ProcessAlarmsAMP3_2] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN s0 CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN LEFT(t.[Source], 5) IN ('27C10','27C30','27C50','27C60','27C70','27C80','27C90') THEN 'Operator1' ELSE 'Operator2' END AS Con) k

GROUP BY DATEDIFF(minute, s0.StartTs, t.[TimeStamp]) / 10),
f AS (SELECT n.s, ISNULL(cnt.n, 0) AS n,
CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(cnt.n, 0) >= 10 THEN n.s END) OVER (ORDER BY n.s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
> ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(cnt.n, 0) < 5 THEN n.s END) OVER (ORDER BY n.s ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), -1)
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS InFlood
FROM nums n LEFT HASH JOIN cnt ON cnt.s = n.s)

'Operator1' AS Console,
CASE WHEN f.InFlood = 0 THEN f.n ELSE 0 END AS Normal,
